title: A mesh-free multiresolution deep energy method with phase-field modeling of brittle fracture
abstract: arXiv:2608.24126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Phase-field modeling of brittle fracture removes the need to track cracks explicitly by recasting their evolution as the minimization of an energy functional. In return it requires a discretization dense enough to resolve a localization band whose width is set by a regularization length and whose path is not known in advance. We propose a mesh-free discretization in which a single neural network represents the displacement and phase fields and is trained by minimizing the incremental energy directly. translated_title: 一种无网格多分辨率深度能量方法及其在脆性断裂相场建模中的应用
translated_abstract: 脆性断裂的相场建模通过将裂纹演化重述为能量泛函的最小化，无需显式追踪裂纹。但相应地，它需要足够密集的离散化来解析一个定位带，该定位带的宽度由正则化长度设定，且其路径事先未知。我们提出了一种无网格离散化方法，其中单个神经网络表示位移场和相场，并通过直接最小化增量能量进行训练。坐标通过由$C^1$二次B样条网格构建的多分辨率特征编码进入网络，因此表示所能表达的最精细尺度由选择决定，而非通过缓慢训练达到，能量则通过在每次优化器迭代时重新绘制的点上的分层蒙特卡洛积分进行估计。这种配对被证明是关键性的，因为当积分点固定时，裂纹无法推进。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无网格多分辨率深度能量方法，利用$C^1$二次B样条特征编码和分层蒙特卡洛积分，有效解决了脆性断裂相场建模中裂纹定位带的离散化难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mesh-free multiresolution deep energy method using $C^1$ quadratic B-spline feature encoding and stratified Monte Carlo integration to effectively resolve crack localization in phase-field modeling of brittle fracture.
